checkMessages: Disposable ordinary document opens.
Fresh isolated settings contain six bundled conversation templates.
Empty template name is rejected without changing saved templates.
Duplicate localized template name is rejected.
Creating a unique template with an empty system prompt is supported.
Editing a saved template preserves its identity and saves the new instruction.
Last remaining draft template cannot be deleted.
Cancel discards template edits, creation, deletion and selection together.
Real prompt control binds Ctrl+Enter to the production Send command.
Actual GGUF output is a Markdown table containing the requested values.
Latest real answer is selected automatically.
Copy preserves original Markdown, participant labels, separators and conversation order in the memory clipboard sink.
Clear selection disables Copy, Insert and Replace.
Select all checks both question and answer.
A failed clipboard sink is reported without changing messages.
Actual follow-up receives the existing conversation and recalls its table value.
Manual message selection survives a subsequent generated answer.
Panel template switching preserves loaded weights, chat, draft and attachments.
Selected shared template persists in the isolated settings store.
Single selected reply copies its unmodified source without participant labels.
Ordinary editable selection enables both transfer commands.
Insert adds a real editable WPF table after the current selection, preserving surrounding text.
One ordinary Undo removes the complete formatted insertion.
One ordinary Redo restores the formatted insertion.
Inserted table cells are independently editable and do not rewrite the source AI reply.
Replace changes only the currently selected ordinary text and preserves both sides.
One ordinary Undo reverses the complete replacement.
Ordinary replacement Redo restores its contents.
Read-only ordinary document blocks AI transfer.
Multi-message ordinary insertion includes ordered participant labels.
One Undo reverses the whole multi-message insertion.
AI transfers modify the editor without silently saving the source file.
Opening Markdown after the answer arrives selects a different current transfer target.
Markdown preview blocks transfer and explains that an editable document is required.
Markdown Insert writes exact source Markdown after the current selection.
One Markdown Undo reverses the complete insertion and updates document state.
One Markdown Redo restores exact inserted source.
Markdown Replace changes only the selected source text.
One Markdown Undo reverses replacement.
Markdown replacement Redo restores exact contents.
Markdown multi-message insertion equals the original ordered Copy payload.
One Undo removes the entire Markdown multi-message insertion.
Current document captures the whole Markdown source, including markup, after switching editors.
Markdown attachment snapshot does not follow later source edits.
Returning from Markdown retains the independent ordinary editor.
A five-file batch retains four accepted cards and reports the attachment limit.
Queued native-picker result uses the production text/binary readers; binary preview is limited to 256 bytes.
Actual file-drop behavior routes disposable paths to the same production attachment command.
Current document attaches the whole ordinary document, not only its selection.
Attached document is an immutable snapshot after subsequent editor changes.
Actual vision request identifies both image colors and the original document snapshot code.
Sent cards move into conversation history and remain available to follow-up questions.
Actual follow-up retains the document/image attachments from the previous turn.
Oversized file is rejected without adding a card.
Empty text file produces its localized attachment error.
New chat clears history, draft, attachments and selection while retaining loaded weights.
Saving template deletion removes only the isolated custom template and retains model weights.
All queued attachment-picker choices consumed.
In-memory settings Save was exercised.
No WPF binding errors.
captureMethod: RenderTargetBitmap of visible production WPF windows
interaction: Production chat/templates/attachment readers/drop behavior and both visible editors; real GGUF/vision, selected-message Copy to an isolated memory sink, native picker decisions queued. See stage9-chat.json. Verify mode reads embedded resources only.
limitations: No personal data, system clipboard, native file-picker gesture, physical input or performance benchmark. Ctrl+Enter binding is inspected; production Send command is executed. Routed Drop uses disposable paths. Model output is real, never substituted.
